sources.quote: Epistola de Tolerantia (A Letter Concerning Toleration) in 1689
Popple’s translation of Locke’s A Letter Concerning Toleration was also published
the Two Treatises and the Letter Concerning Toleration were published anonymously
he only published his Epistola de Tolerantia (A Letter Concerning Toleration) in 1689
he wrote a work entitled Epistola de Tolerantia, which was published anonymously in 1689

notes: Nguyên bản tiếng Latin (Epistola de Tolerantia) in 1689; bản tiếng Anh của Popple cũng ra sau khi Locke về nước năm 1689 (SEP). Tên tiếng Anh là tên bản dịch Popple, hợp lý.
